spans.text: A third uninvited guest walks through the night and arrives at this deserted building.
Is it over?
Before her are the ragged remains in the wake of the gunfight.
The acrid smell of gunsmoke still has not dissipated after so long.
Alia...
...Aliana...
Tap-tap-tap—
SCR's footsteps echo slowly through the quiet building.
When she reaches the top floor, she sees a Doll lying in the middle of a ruined room.
A shaft of moonlight shines in through the broken window, shining on the fallen Aliana.
Aliana's hands are covering her face, but even though her expression isn't visible, there is an unspoken sadness flowing out from her.
I... I'm free at last.
But... I can't go back.
SCR doesn't know if Aliana noticed her presence.
No... There's no way she couldn't have noticed.
It's just that... right now, nothing is more important to her.
Why didn't you tell her that, actually, you...
SCR ventures an attempt at conversation as she walks up to Aliana.
...And what would have been the point? Would they have come back to life if I had told her?
...Still, even if you didn't say it...
Those reasons are still valid.
If you didn't tell anyone else about them, doesn't that mean you're depriving yourself of the right to be forgiven by others?
...It's all the same in the end.
SCR sits down beside Aliana without a word and hugs her knees.
She glances at Aliana. The latter is still covering her face with her hands and her expression can't be seen.
With the moon hanging high in the sky, SCR leans back and lies down beside Aliana.
...She took away everyone else's data.
Isn't that a good thing? Now you're yourself again.
Yeah...
I once said that I was strong even without their data.
But nobody believed me.
...The fact is, Operation Couatl was still a failure even with their strength.
A loser has no right to explain all this.
...You'll make it.
Even if you didn't succeed 13 years ago, then... you can try again 13 years later.
Yeah, how can I die when the enemy's still alive?
In the future, I'll keep the daybreak going...
Even if I have to do it myself...
SCR freezes up, and then turns to look at Aliana.
So, which of you won?
...Were you prepared to die at her hands too?
Would it have been a reunion of sorts?
In the darkness, SCR does not hear an answer.
The sporadic pattering of rain filters in from outside the window, making the gloomy night that much colder.
Nobody else speaks on this silent night.
In the Ops Room of the Griffin Base.
...The Griffin Base, which had been quiet and largely empty for the past few days, now sees many Dolls moving back and forth within its corridors.
However, the one thing that stays the same is that lively air of the Griffin Base in days past is long gone. Everyone's faces are serious and stern.
This cold, oppressive air fills every corner of Griffin and nobody is free of it.
And in the eye of this storm, an important conversation is taking place within the Ops Room.
Aliana is standing in the middle of the darkened room, facing the probing gaze of the person before her.
There is little time for them to talk, and the Commander has much work that needs to be done apart from Aliana.
Even so, the Commander is still willing to make time for Aliana.
So according to Persica, your neural cloud issues are all resolved?
Yes.
My performance might drop briefly, but don't worry, I'll be back up to speed soon enough.
I have full confidence in you.
However...
The Commander sighs.
We're not fighting unconventional warfare anymore.
Did you know that we could have been arrested for breaking and entering into a private residence?
I'm sorry...
Bail is nothing, but the problem is that our time is very tight.
...I'm sorry.
I'll accept any form of punishment.
Then your punishment will be to lead your team, but I'll be giving you tougher assignments.
Can you accept that?
I don't want my neural cloud to be modified in any way, though.
That is still your prerogative.
It's just like we agreed at the beginning.
...Thank you.
That Laplace you mentioned is a very important clue and also our common objective.
I don't want there to be any unnecessary misunderstandings between us.
I hope you can trust me with all of your heart.
...Yes, I will be loyal to you.
Don't take Dandelion's little pranks to heart.
...Alright.
...Then let us fight together, Aliana.
Aliana emerges from the Ops Room. There is someone waiting for her there.
Shall we head to the range?
...Let's go.
A new day will always dawn.
And the sun will rise as always.
Goodbye, Amaris.
